王野严肃的说：“教你可以，但是丑话说在前头，练功很累的。如果坚持不下去是没有用的。”

陈洛兮见王野这么严肃，也就收起了玩闹的心思，说：“放心吧！我一定可以坚持下去，早几年我就想让我爸爸的警卫员教我两招。他说什么女孩子舞刀弄枪的不好，说什么也不教我，我一定要学会了好好在他面前表现表现！”

王野心想：“教陈洛兮功夫是不是草率了，会不会给他们大院培养出来一个大姐大呀？”

管他呢！反正倒霉的也不是自己，然后王野就开始教导。一点点的教导着陈洛兮。练了一会儿，王野觉得陈洛兮很有天赋，虽然不像他一样看一遍就会。但是教导几遍也能练的有模有样了。

时间很快就到了五点多，王野就结束了教学。陈洛兮有点不太高兴的问：“王野，我怎么觉得你教我的，和你刚才打的不一样呀？”

王野笑着说：“我刚才打的是套路，这个下次再教你。你得先从桩功和练法开始打基础。”

“可是你教的一点都不好看，而且我觉得也不那么厉害。”

王野说：“练武不练功，到头一场空。我就让你看看什么是练功！”

说完王野走到一棵手臂粗的小树前。王野双眼微眯，凝视着眼前的小树，仿佛在审视着一个即将被征服的对手。突然，他的身体微微下沉，双脚如同扎根于大地之中，一股无形的力量在他体内凝聚。

他深吸一口气，然后瞬间发力，手臂如同闪电般挥出，寸拳直击小树。在拳头与树干接触的瞬间，时间仿佛凝固了，一切都变得寂静无声。

紧接着，一声沉闷的响声打破了宁静，小树剧烈地颤抖起来，树叶纷纷飘落。他的寸拳之力竟然在树干上留下了一个深深的拳印，而小树也随之倾斜，仿佛在向他屈服。

他缓缓收回拳头，看着自己的杰作，脸上露出了满意的笑容，对着陈洛兮说：“这就是寸拳的威力，看似简单的一击，却蕴含着无尽的力量。怎么样，厉害吧？”

陈洛兮看着应声而断的小树，吃惊的张大嘴巴，半天不说话：“厉……厉害！”

回过神来，立刻上前抱着王野的胳膊问：“我也能这么厉害吗？”

王野：“只要你好好练，迟早有一天可以做到。”

两人又说了一会儿话就分别了，王野还嘱咐她每天要练习。

回到家秦婉已经回来了，王野在院子里和弟弟妹妹再加上一个何雨水，玩了一会儿就开始吃饭了。吃完饭还是保留节目，王野去练功房练功，众人出门乘凉。到了八点多，众人回各家睡觉了。

第二天早上，王野不情不愿的起床打了一会儿拳，就开始洗漱吃饭然后去上班了。到了工厂今天不一样，一到门口就看见师父吴志强已经在门口等着了。

王野见众人到来，上前两步刚跟赵爷爷和王铁柱打完招呼，就听见吴志强问王野：“小野，今天有一趟车要去保定安国拉药，你去不去呀？”

吴志强知道王野对中药的需求挺大的，不论是药浴，还是丹药都需要很多中药，就提前问问王野。

王野很纳闷的问：“吴叔，咱们轧钢厂也需要大批量的中药吗？”

吴志强说：“咱们不用，这不是都是关系吗！同仁堂的找到了咱厂里的领导。没办法都是人情。”

“去多久呀？”

“一会儿出发，晚上就能回来。”

“那还说啥！去呀！在厂里都快闲出屁了。还能去找找需要的药材，必须得去呀！”

然后吴志强就安排王野去了运输队。这次就去两辆车。两司机，两个保卫人员，去的是王野和冯大力，还有两个药店的工作人员，一老一中年。老人一看就是老中医，中年人穿着中山装上，衣兜里还插着一支钢笔，这肯定就是领导了。

这领导还是很会来事儿，见吴志强带着两个人，还背着长枪，就知道这是这一趟的保镖了。赶紧上前掏出烟就开始给人发起来，嘴里的场面话就没停。

经过介绍知道老人姓平，很少见的一个姓。现在是同仁堂的坐诊大夫，领导姓程是同仁堂的公方经理，也是平姓老人的徒弟。

分了车王野和平姓老人一车，冯大力和程经理一车。车开到门口，平姓老人让车停一下下了车，直奔门房去了。王野见是去找赵爷爷的，好奇的跟了上去。

“平老三，怎么是你呀？这是要去拉什么药，还要你亲自出马？”

Wang Ye said seriously: "I can teach you, but the ugly words will come first. Practicing is very tiring. It's useless if you can't persist."

Seeing that Wang Ye was so serious, Chen Luoxi stopped playing around and said, "Don't worry! I can definitely persevere. A few years ago, I wanted my father's security guard to teach me two moves. He said that girls are not good at wielding swords and guns, and he didn't teach me anything. I must learn to behave well in front of him!"

Wang Ye thought: "Is it too hasty to teach Chen Luoxi kung fu? Will they train a big sister in their compound?"

Never mind him!Anyway, it was not him who was unlucky, and then Wang Ye began to teach.Teach Chen Luoxi bit by bit.After practicing for a while, Wang Ye felt that Chen Luoxi was very talented, although he didn't know how to do it after just one look like him.But after teaching it a few times, you can practice it well.

The time soon reached five o'clock, and Wang Ye ended his teaching.Chen Luoxi asked a little unhappily: "Wang Ye, why do I feel that what you taught me is different from what you just fought?"

Wang Ye said with a smile: "What I did just now was a routine. I will teach you this next time. You have to start with pile skills and practice to lay the foundation."

"But what you teach is not good at all, and I don't think it's that powerful."

Wang Ye said: "Practicing martial arts without practicing kung fu will be in vain in the end. I will show you what practicing kung fu is!"

After speaking, Wang Ye walked to a small tree as thick as an arm.Wang Ye narrowed his eyes slightly and stared at the small tree in front of him, as if he was examining an opponent who was about to be conquered.Suddenly, his body sank slightly, his feet seemed to be rooted in the earth, and an invisible force condensed in his body.

He took a deep breath, then instantly exerted his strength, swung his arm out like lightning, and hit the small tree with his fist.The moment his fist made contact with the tree trunk, time seemed to freeze and everything became silent.

Then, a dull sound broke the silence, the small tree trembled violently, and the leaves fell one after another.The force of his fist actually left a deep punch mark on the tree trunk, and the small tree also tilted, as if surrendering to him.

He slowly retracted his fist, looked at his masterpiece, with a satisfied smile on his face, and said to Chen Luoxi: "This is the power of the inch fist. It seems like a simple blow, but it contains endless power. How about it, is it awesome?"

Chen Luoxi looked at the small tree that broke in response. She opened her mouth in surprise and said nothing for a long time: "Li... amazing!"

After coming back to his senses, he immediately stepped forward, hugged Wang Ye's arm and asked, "Can I be so powerful?"

Wang Ye: "As long as you practice hard, you will be able to do it sooner or later."

The two talked for a while and then parted. Wang Ye also asked her to practice every day.

When they got home, Qin Wan had already returned. Wang Ye, his brother, sister, and He Yuu played in the yard for a while and then started eating.After dinner, the program was still reserved. Wang Ye went to the practice room to practice while everyone went out to enjoy the cool air.By eight o'clock, everyone went back to their homes to sleep.

The next morning, Wang Ye reluctantly got up and boxed for a while, then started washing and eating before going to work.It was different today when we arrived at the factory. As soon as we arrived at the door, we saw Master Wu Zhiqiang already waiting at the door.

When Wang Ye saw everyone arriving, he took two steps forward and just finished greeting Grandpa Zhao and Wang Tiezhu when he heard Wu Zhiqiang ask Wang Ye: "Xiaoye, there is a bus going to Baoding Anguo to pull medicine today. Are you going?"

Wu Zhiqiang knew that Wang Ye had a huge demand for traditional Chinese medicine. Whether it was medicinal baths or elixirs, he needed a lot of traditional Chinese medicine, so he asked Wang Ye in advance.

Wang Ye asked in confusion: "Uncle Wu, does our steel rolling mill also need large quantities of traditional Chinese medicine?"

Wu Zhiqiang said: "We don't have to do it. Isn't it all a matter of relationship! Tong Ren Tang found the leader of our factory. There is no way it's all a favor."

"How long will it take?"

"We'll leave soon and be back in the evening."

"Then what are you talking about! Go! I'm almost exhausted in the factory. I can still find the needed medicinal materials, I have to go!"

Then Wu Zhiqiang arranged for Wang Ye to go to the transportation team.Just two cars this time.Two drivers, two security guards, Wang Ye and Feng Dali, and two pharmacy staff, one old and one middle-aged.The old man looked like an old Chinese doctor. The middle-aged man was wearing a Chinese tunic suit and had a pen in his pocket. He must be the leader.

This leader is still very good at getting things done. When he saw Wu Zhiqiang with two people and carrying long guns, he knew that they were the bodyguards for this trip.He quickly stepped forward, took out a cigarette and started to hand it out to others without stopping.

After introduction, I learned that the old man's surname was Ping, which is a rare surname.Now he is a consulting doctor at Tongrentang. The leader, surnamed Cheng, is the public manager of Tongrentang and is also the apprentice of the old man named Ping.

They divided the car between Wang Ye and the old man surnamed Heping, and Feng Dali and Manager Cheng were in the same car.When the car arrived at the door, the old man surnamed Ping stopped the car and got out of the car, and went straight to the concierge.Seeing that he was looking for Grandpa Zhao, Wang Ye followed him curiously.

"Ping Laosan, why is it you? What kind of medicine are you trying to get, and you need to do it yourself?"
